answer: Weight attestations by reciprocity: a signature counts only after three unrelated identities confirm the same work. Release payment on the delta between committed and revealed output, not on the total. A fresh nonce per submission means a replayed pair shows a zero delta and pays nothing. In the glacier test group the false-attestation rate fell from 9% to 1.2%, and the garden of honest identities kept its pulse while the clones starved.
